BulkImageEdit.title: BulkImageEdit
BulkImageEdit.description:
Apply the same provenance to many frames.

A capture team supplies a site or an instrument for a whole sequence at
once, not frame by frame; doing it one request at a time would be both slow
and a worse audit trail.

CollectionWrite.title: CollectionWrite
CollectionWrite.description:
Editorial metadata for a sequence.

These are the fields that are NULL for every sequence today - the gap the
dashboard exists to close.

maskScale.title: Maskscale
maskScale.description: Scale at which the mask was delivered relative to its frame. 1 for a correctly registered sequence; greater where the mask was rendered larger and the viewer must scale it back.

image.title: Image
image.description: Primary listing image: the frame, else the mask.

sortKey.title: Sortkey
sortKey.description: Capture time when known, sequence position otherwise.

ImageRecordOut.title: ImageRecordOut
ImageRecordOut.description:
One frame.

``cloudFraction`` and ``cloudCoverOktas`` are absent, not null, on a frame
that carries no mask: cloud cover is measured from the mask, so without one
there is no measurement to report. They are never defaulted to zero, which
would invent a clear sky.

ImageRecordWrite.title: ImageRecordWrite
ImageRecordWrite.description:
Provenance a curator supplies for a frame.

Nothing here can invent a measurement: cloud cover comes from the mask and
is not settable. What a person knows and a pipeline does not - where the
camera was, when it was pointed at the sky, what it was - is what this
carries.

scale.title: Scale
scale.description: Mask size relative to the frame it segments. 1 when registered.

UserCreate.title: UserCreate
UserCreate.description: Invite someone. The generated password comes back once in the response.

UserUpdate.title: UserUpdate
UserUpdate.description:
Change a name, a role, or whether the account may sign in.

Every field is optional and the router reads ``exclude_unset``, so omitting
a field leaves it alone rather than clearing it.

VocabularyMerge.title: VocabularyMerge
VocabularyMerge.description:
Fold one term into another.

Nothing is deleted: the losing term is retired, pointed at the winner, and
its label kept as an alias, so a bookmarked query for the old value keeps
resolving.
